svg.title: Tensor parallelism in a transformer attention layer across 4 GPUs
svg.desc: Column-parallel Q/K/V projection split across 4 GPUs, local attention per GPU, then row-parallel output projection summed via all-reduce into a replicated output Y.
svg.text: One forward pass · no communication until output projection
Column split: X is replicated; each GPU holds d/4 columns of W_Q/K/V → computes its own Q, K, V slices independently.
Row split: Z_i is seq×d/4; W_O shard is d/4×d → partial output Y_i is seq×d. All-reduce sums all Y_i → full Y.
Communication cost: 1 all-reduce forward · 1 all-reduce backward → 2 collectives per layer total
